command: set -o pipefail; export JAVA_HOME="$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21)"; set +e; ./gradlew :core:data:detekt --rerun-tasks --console=plain 2>&1 | tee /tmp/p2c-v11-detekt.log; rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; echo '--- DETEKT REPORT FILES ---'; find core/data/build/reports -maxdepth 3 -type f -iname '*detekt*' -print 2>/dev/null || true; for f in core/data/build/reports/detekt/detekt.txt core/data/build/reports/detekt/detekt.xml core/data/build/reports/detekt/detekt.md; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then echo "--- $f ---"; cat "$f"; fi; done; echo '--- DETEKT ERROR LINES ---'; grep -E '(^|/).+\.kt:[0-9]+|LongParameterList|TooMany|MagicNumber|Naming|Unused|complexity|style|potential-bugs' /tmp/p2c-v11-detekt.log || true; exit $rc
